title: AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b crashes when trying to use quick wizzard
symptom: AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b crashes immediately as soon as you try to open the quick wizard.
cause: The crash may be caused by old quick wizard entries from 3.2.x in the new 3.3.x quick wizard code.
fix: Delete old quick wizard entries and create new quick wizard buttons as a workaround.
evidence_quote: deleting the old QW entries and create new QW buttons did help indeed. thx
